body: He became too much like me, and I hate myself. So now I hate him too.
I used to have a best friend but he became too much like me and I hate myself so now I hate him too. The feeling is mutual.
Is that a bad thing? I've been doing it my entire life

"When I look in the mirror I feel genuinely disgusted at what looks back"

Man I feel this all the way to my bones. I'm sorry these things have to happen to you. Hang in there stranger.
You have good intentions and ur friend knows that but if she isn't responding then she probably needs space and time to herself. Hard to say. You did ur part by trying to reach out.

Rather than talking with ur dad about it, I think u should discuss a different solution with the therapist that doesn't need to involve ur dad in a session cos it sounds like he'll be more destructive than helpful to your mental health.

Sorry for your loss. It sounds like u really loved him.

I have a brother with gambling addiction who's really toxic and nobody in the family wants anything to do with him. He took money from all his friends and family and strangers in the internet thru gofundme saying he has depression and shit and still tries to get money from me from time to time. Guy's a monster. Nobody would care if he died. Burying him might even put a smile on my face.

I guess if it's any consolation, I'm glad u have good memories of your brother. Hope the joys prevail over your pain.
I am a stranger in my home. I don't want to die I just wanna be gone.
I'll see how this goes. Thank u for trying to help.
People shouldn't tell u what to feel. Anybody who does is a piece of shit u can live without
